clauses.label: sole paragraph
clauses.text:
By virtue of the authority vested in me 
by section 5 of title 2 of the Canal Zone 
Code, approved June 19, 1934, and as 
President of the United States, Execu­
tive Order No. 2006 of July 30,1914, plac­
ing certain land in the Canal Zone, at 
Darien, under the control of the Secre­
tary of the Navy for use as a naval radio 
station, is hereby revoked, and such land 
returned to the control and jurisdiction 
of the Governor of The Panama Canal.
